title: ContextMint | AI Writes Code. We Decide What Can Ship.
description: ContextMint is a local-first AI decision-control plane — evidence before inference, human approval before repo changes. v1.0 ships end of August 2026.

hero.subAfter: for software teams — not generic chat. Review retrieved evidence before the model answers. Approve patches before anything applies. Code stays on your infrastructure by default.

finalCta.title: Govern AI velocity without silent applies
finalCta.line1: The question is no longer whether AI writes your code.
finalCta.line2: It is whether humans see evidence before it ships.
